tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag mkhas pa gong ma'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba rnams lhan cig tu sgrigs pa legs bshad mkhas pa'i kha rgyan bzhugs// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan rtsis las 'byung ba'i chos rgyal rigs ldan gyi grangs dang sprul gzhi ni/ dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams la chos rgyal rigs ldan gyi grangs sum cu rtsa gsum du bzhed pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis mkhas pa'i rgyan las/ thub dbang shing pho byi ba la bltams nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs/ de nas lo drug dka' ba spyad/ so bdun pa sa mo phag la mngon par byang chub/ brgyad cu bzhes pa chu mo lug gi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i nya la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud gsungs nas/ sa ga'i nya la mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan/ lo de nyid la zla ba bzang pos shambha lar rtsa rgyud spel zhing 'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa brtsam/ gzhal med khang bzhengs nas shing sprel lo shar ba na zhi bar gshegs/ lo de nyid nas brtsams te lha dbang dang / gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan te drug ni chos rgyal dang / shing sprel nas grags pas lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan nas/ chu mo phag la bsdus rgyud gsungs/ shing pho byi ba nas pad dkar dang / bzang po/ bshes gnyen bzang / phyag dmar can/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang po rnams kyi bsdus rgyud bstan cing / sprel lo la ma ga dhar kla klo zhugs/ shambha lar rgya mtsho rnam rgyal byon/ de nas rgyal dka' dang / nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong / seṅge/ rnam gnon/ stobs po che/ ma 'gags pa/

mi'i seṅge/ dbang phyug chen po/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal/ grags pa phyi ma/ drag po 'khor lo can te chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyer drug tu gsungs pa ni/ dri med 'od kyis 'jig rten khams lo'i 'grel par rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs pa las/ grags pa rigs ldan rigs kyang ste/ /zhes pa nas/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /zhes pa'i bar gyis rigs ldan nyer bzhi pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal rdzogs rjes su/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /rigs ldan grags pa 'byung 'gyur te/ /smra mkhas rta mchog ting 'dzin gyis/ /kla klo'i chos ni mthar byed pa'o/ /zhes 'jam dpal grags pa nyid mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs pa grags pa phyi ma nyid yin zhing / de'i sras drag po 'khor lo can te/ rigs ldan nyer drug tu bzhed pa ni/ bsdus rgyud las kyang / gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrang pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ rigs ldan rigs la lha'i mchog gis bstud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur zhes pa dang / chos rgyal rigs ldan yongs sdom pas sum cu rtsa gsum byung ba yang / bsdus rgyud las/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lor 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i/ 'di gnyis kyi mtha'i don 'jug la bshad pa yod kyang 'di ni rdzogs pa'i don yin pas/ rigs ldan nyer drug pa dang / de'i steng chos rgyal bdun gnan pas so gsum pa 'khor lo can yin par 'dod lags/ 'dis lung gis rigs ldan drag po phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin pa yang 'grub ste/ phyag na 'khor lo 'gyur zhes pa/ /phyag na rdo rje drag po 'khor lo can du 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /rje btsun rin po ches kyang / phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ drag po kāl ki zhes bya'i bar/ /zhes dang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas sdom gsum las kyang /

snyigs ma'i dus na 'phags pa'i yul/ /kla klo'i chos kyi gang bar 'gyur/ /de nas kla klo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /shambha la ru dmag 'dren 'gyur/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal pos kla klo kun bcom nas/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi bar du yang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs shing / des kyang ma zad mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis/ phyag na rdo rje dang / thugs rdo rje dang / dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa'i skabs 'dir/ chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug ste sum cu so gsum po thams cad sprul byed phyag na rdo rje'i dus kyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig gi sprul pa yin pas/ sprul pa so so la bkod pa mi 'dra ba dang / sprul byed kyi mtshan so sor yod kyang 'gal ba med de/ dri med 'od kyi 'jig rten khams le'i 'grel par/ 'di dag sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag ston pa po dang / zhu ba po'i 'grel pa/ sprul pa'i sku'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus kyang rung ste/ snga ma dang phyi mar 'gal ba med do/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal po zla ba bzang pos sems can thams cad kyi phyir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa la zhus so/ /snga ma'i rnam grangs gsum dang / 'khor can zhes pa rnam grangs yin te/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa las/ rdo rje can nam rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /zhes pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang dri med 'od kyi nang le'i 'grel par/ phyi rol du le'u dang po nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo can gang yin pa de ni/ lus la rdo rje can de thugs rdo rje'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par 'grub pa'i phyir ro/

/'o na chos rgyal rigs ldan 'di rnams seṅge'i khri la 'khod nas lo grangs du tsam chos bstan na/ mkhas mchog phal cher gyis rags rtsis kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ lo grangs brgya brgyar chos gsungs so zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ sprul pa'i rgyal po re re bzhin/ /lo grangs brgya ni lhag pa ru/ /seṅge khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /chos kyis 'jig rten skyong bar mdzad/ /de nas rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ /shambha la yi yul du ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud/ /nam yang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ de yang bstan pa'i gnas tshad/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs 'di nyid dang sbyar na/ rtsa rgyud gsungs nas lo sum stong sum brgya dang nyag bzhi gnas pa las/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos lo gcig dang / gzhan chos rgyal rigs ldan bzhi lo brgya brgyar chos bstan pas/ de la lo sum stong nyis brgya dang gcig las ma byung yang / brgya phrag lhag ma ru zhes pa'i don/ gong du ma tshang ba'i lo brgya dang gsum yod pa 'di so gnyis po so so la sbyor dgos pa la dgongs so/ /de yang shin tu zhib par ri mos gtan la phab nas brtsis na/ so gnyis po re re la lo gsum/ zla ba gnyis/ zhag bcwo brgyad/ chu tshod zhe lnga pa re re/ lo grangs brgya brgya'i steng du bsnon dgos pas rje btsun gyi dgongs pa yang 'grub cing / 'di shin tu legs pa yin nam snyam pa bdag gi blo la shar lags/ yang bu ston rin po che'i zab don sgo 'byed rin po che'i lde mig ces bya ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud zla ba bzang po la gsungs nas/ zla bzang gis kyang rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus/ 'grel bshad sde sbyor du rjes su bsngags pa'i stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad cing / glegs bam la bris nas shambha la la sogs pa'i yul gyi mi rnams la bstan/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rin po che sna lnga las bzhengs pa rdzu 'phrul bstan pa mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas lha dbang dang / gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan rnams kyi lo brgya brgyar chos bstan no/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs grags pas lo brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan te de yan chad rtsa rgyud rtsa 'grel la 'chad nyan byed pa yin no/ /rtsa rgyud las/ lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i los/ /zhes pa nas/ chos bstan pa'i lo ste zhes dang / nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya zhes pa dang / zla bzang mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya rnams gnad cig tu rtogs dgos so/ /de nas grags pas lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan pa'i rjes su grags pas kyang dkar la rgyud ston cing 'grel bshad rtsom par bskos shing mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas pad dkar gyis 'grel bshad stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad cing chos bstan no/ /de nas bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / bshes gnyen bzang po dang / phyag dmar dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags dang / shin tu bzang ste brgyad pos lo brgya brgyar chos ston par gsal te/ de nas kla klo'i chos 'jug par gsungs zhing / de rjes rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka' yis kyang lo brgya brgyar chos ston par gsal te/ kla klo byung nas lo brgya brgyad cu rtsa gnyis na/ rgyal dka' yis rtsis gzhi brtsam la brgya nibargya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi dus yin la/ rgyal dka' yis chos bstan nas lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis na/ bsdus rgyud kyi rtsis gzhi mdzad dam bsam mo/ /de nas nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang / dpal skyong dang / seṅge dang / rnam gnon dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gags pa dang / mi'i seṅge dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas dang / rnam rgyal dang / drag po 'khor lo can ste des kla klo'i stobs 'joms par byed do/

/de'i dbus gdan gyi nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rim par yongs su bgrang pa dag gis dus kyi mthar/ zhes pa rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rjes thogs su drag po 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po bdun ste sprul pa'i rgyal po sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /zhes gong ma dag bzhed do/ /yang na mtha' yas rnam rgyal gcig tu byas nas nyi shu rtsa lnga gdan gyi mtha' ma/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rigs ldan drag por byas na/ pad dkar gyis rjes sprul pa'i rgyal po sum cu rtsa gsum lung bstan pa dang mthun no/ /zhes lugs gnyis su gsung 'dug cing / yang chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rdo rje'i mdud 'grol las/ da ni rang gi lugs lung dang sbyar nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang thub pa'i dbang po bltam nas da lta'i drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo 'di yan la 'das lo nyis stong sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi 'das pa yin te/ de yang gang las shes zhes na/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po nyid lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du khab tu bzhugs shing / de nas dka' ba spyad pa lo drug tu mdzad pas lo so lnga/ de'i phyi lo sangs rgyas shing theg pa gsum gyi chos ston par mdzad pa la lo gcig ste lo so drug /de'i phyi lo nag pa'i nya la rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i lo gcig ste so bdun/ de nas rgyal po zla ba bzang pos rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang gzhal med khang bzhengs pa sogs kyi lo gcig ste lo so brgyad dang / de nas lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo yi gsal bar mi bdag grags pa shambha la zhes bya bar 'byung zhes pa la/ lo 'di zhes pa ni de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan pa'i lo ste lo de nas lo drug brgya na/ chu bo shīrta'i byang / shambha la zhes bya ba'i yul du grags pa zhes pa ni lung gi brjod pa ste 'jam dpal grags pa chen po gsal bar byung zhes pa sprul pa'i sku 'dzin par mdzad par 'gyur zhes pa'i don to/

/rtsa rgyud gsungs nas lo drug brgya na rgyal po grags pa 'byung bar gsung pa ni dus nye ba la dgongs shing / rgyud gsungs pa nas lo drug brgya'i mgo ma zug pa'i bar du rgyal po zla ba bzang pos blos blangs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa sogs kyi lo gcig snon pa yin te/ 'jig rten khams le'u mdor bsdus gsum par/ de bzhin gshegs pa nges pa de'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / rgyas 'grel stong phrag drug cu pa yang shambha la la sogs pa'i yul gyi skad du gzhan gyi glegs bam la bris nas rgyal po zla ba bzang pos grong bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa rnams la rab tu bstan to/ /de nyid de la mos pa rnams kyis mnyan cing bklags te rang gi sems la bzung nas gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu bstan to/ /rgyud bstan pa'i dus de nas lo gnyis pa la sems can rnams kyi dngos grub rgyu'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang rdzu 'phrul bstan nas sprul pa'i sku gang nas byon pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid gshegs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de nas lo drug brgya po'i bar la lha dbang nas lha'i dbang ldan gyi bar chos rgyal chen po drug gis lo brgya brgyar chos ston pa yin te/ gong gi 'grel tshig de ma thag par/ de nas lha'i dbang gis lo brgya'i bar du rgyud ston par mdzad de/ de bzhin du gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan gyis kyang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal ldan rgyud las lo drug brgya'i rjes la klu'i lo brgya gsungs na yang / de gnyis kyi bar du rgyal po grags pa chos gsungs pa'i lo brgya yong rgyu yin te/ slar yang gong gi 'grel tshig de ma thag par/ nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa'i sku lha'i dbang ldan 'di'i lha mo sna tshogs yum gyi mngal du 'jam dpal rgyal po grags par gyur te byang chub sems dpa' seṅge'i khri de las lo brgya'i bar du chos bstan to/

/zhes gsungs so/ /de nas lo brgya brgya na kla klo 'jug pa yin te/ 'jig rten khams le'i tshigs nyer drug par/ de nas klu'i lo brgya rnams kyis nges par ma ga'i yul du ma ga'i chos dag rab tu 'jug zhes gsungs pa'i klu'i lo brgya ni lo brgyad brgya'o/ /de'i bar la rigs ldan brgyad 'byung ba yin te/ 'jig rten khams le'i tshig bcad drug par/ rigs ldan rigs kyi nang nas lag pas bsgyur ba'i dus kyi bu dang tsha bo dag ni 'das gyur pa/ de yis dus su nges par ma ga'i yul du kla klo'i chos ni rab tu 'jug par 'gyur zhes pa'i lag pa gnyis dang / bsgyur bya'i dus ni bzhi'o/ /rigs ldan brgyad pos lo brgya brgyar chos gsungs pa'i rigs ldan ni 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i bu rigs ldan padma dkar po dang / tsha bo bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / bshes gnyen bzang po dang / rin chen phyag dang / khyab 'jug pus pa dang / nyi ma grags dang / shin tu bzang po rnams so/ /klu'i lo brgya po rdzogs nas kla klo'i chos kyi mgo 'jug pas/ de phyin kla klo'i lor ston pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsa rgyud las/ me mkha' rgya mtsho rnams la rab byung la sogs 'das pa rnams bsres kla klo'i lo ni rab tu grub/ zhes gsungs shing / lo grangs 'di'i thog nas rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyis chos gsungs pa lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang / rgyal dkas lo nyis brgya dang nyer gcig tu chos gsungs pa yin no/ /lo grangs pa 'di'i bar la rigs ldan gnyis las ma byung ba lung gi gsal bar bstan pa ni/ rgyud las gong gi rgyud tshig de ma thag par/ kla klo'i dbang po'i lag pa gdengs can zla bas dman pa'i lhag ma dag kyang nyi las bsgyur/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ kla klo'i dbang po'i lo ni/ lag pa gdeng can zla bas dman pa/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sangs rgyas dman pa ni lag pa gdeng can zla bas dman pa'i lhag rgyal kas byed rtsis brtsam pa'i lor gsungs pas de ltar grub pa yin no/

/me mkha' rgya mtsho yan gyi lo yi phung po de rnams kyi steng du me mkha' rgya mtsho man rab byung nas bzung ba'i drug cu skor drug la lo sum brgya drug cu dang / da lta'i drag po zhes pa lcags sprel 'di yan la nyag lnga bcu rtsa gsum 'das pa rnams dril bas nyams stong sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi grub pa yin no/ /lugs 'di la me mkha' rgya mtsho nas rtsis gzhi rnam dag ma'i gyen log gi rtsis byas pas/ thub pa'i dbang po 'khrungs pa'i skabs kyi gza' skar rnams 'grub pa'o/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho man gyi rgyas bshad ni bshad zin la/ kla klo'i chos kyi mgo zug pa/ /zhes pa nas mjug gi bar go sla mod/ 'on kyang spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du dam tshig don bsdus te bshad par bya'o/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho man la rigs lnga bcu bzhi 'byon zhing / de rnams kyi'ang lo brgya re chos gsungs pa yin la/ de yang rigs ldan nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang / dpal skyong dang / seṅge dang / rnam snon dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gags pa dang / mi'i seṅge dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / rigs ldan drag po rnams so/ /rigs ldan drag pos chos gsungs nas lo dgu bcu rtsa bdun song ba dang / kla klo'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs pas lo gsum gyi bar la kla klo 'joms pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar yang dar bar mdzad do zhes rigs ldan nyer lnga pa'i phyogs gsungs 'dug cing / yang bdun dang 'od zer ri gza' thub pa 'di rnams de bzhin snying stobs ldan pa lha'i skye gnas te/ zhes pa la 'thad tshul mi 'dra ba mang po gsungs kyang / 'dir rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du gzhan bcu bsnan pas/ bdun lnga sum cu so lnga lha'i skye gnas can du ston pa yin la/ des na 'od zer zhes pa bdun gyi brda tshig yin la/ de bzhin du ri dang /

gza' dang / thub pa rnams kyang bdun gyi brda tshig yin pas/ de ltar na bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du tshangs pa dang / lha dbang dang / 'od srung gsum bsnan pas nyi shu rtsa brgyad yin la/ bdun dang 'od zer zhes pa'i bdun tshan dang po ni zla bzang la sogs pa'i chos rgyal bdun te/ mdor na bdun tshan lnga gsum bcwo lnga po 'di lha'i skye gnas yin zhes pa'i don no zhes kyang gsungs la/ yang stag tshang lo tsā ba'i legs bshad bstan pa rgya mtsho las/ lugs 'di la bstan pa yun 'di srid du gnas zhes pa'i lo grangs sogs mdo sde'i phyogs gzhan lung bstan pa dang / gsal bar bshad pa med mod kyi/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na 'jam dbyangs grags pa byung ba dang / de nas grags pa rang nyid kyis lo brgya dang bcas pa'i dgu brgya na kla klo byung ba dang / kla klo'i chos de lo stong brgyad brgya'i bar du 'jug cing / de nas 'khor lo can gyi kla klo bcom nas sangs rgyas kyi chos 'jog par bshad pa rnams kyis/ 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad rtogs par nus la/ de bzhin du sa dum bu re re la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'jug pa dang / de kla klo'i chos kyi nyams par byed pa dang / de 'khor lo can gyis bcom nas rang gi chos kyang dum bu re la lo stong brgyad brgyar bshad pa rnams kyis 'dzam gling chen por ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad kyang rtogs par nus so/ /'o na rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi thog tu byon byon gyi bar dang / rigs ldan shin tu bzang man chod ni re res lo brgya brgyar chos ston par shin tu gsal bar gsung mod kyis/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal man chod kyis rigs ldan rnams kyis ji tsam chos ston pa mi gsal zhing / drag po 'khor lo can gyis ni de ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pas so zhe na/ 'di la kha cig 'khor lo can rigs ldan nyer lnga par byas/

de rang gi lo brgya pa rtsis kyang lo drug brgya las ma byung pas/ me mkha' rgya mtsho las rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / de'i sras rgyal dka' bgos nas/ yab la lag pa gdeng can zla ba dang / sras la nyis brgya nyer gcig sbyar nas/ de gnyis la brgya brgya'i nges pa mi sbyor/ gzhan thams cad brgya brgyar nges par 'dod par byed do/ /de ltar na deng sang rigs ldan mtha' yas kyis chos bstan nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das par 'dod do/ /'di ni lung rigs kyi sgrub byed gsal po med bzhin du 'dod pas sbyar ba'i rnam gzhag tu snang ste/ rigs ldan nyer lnga la gzhan rnams brgya brgyar nges nas de gnyis la zur pa 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor lo can rigs ldan nyer lnga par byed pa'ang mi rigs te/ 'od zer bdun dang ri gza' thub rnams 'dir ni de bzhin snying stobs ldan pa lha'i skye gnas te/ de go le'i skabs su babs gsungs pa'i/ bdun dang ri dang gza' dang thub pa ste lha'i skye gnas bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad mi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du 'khor lo can dang / de'i sras 'jam dpal dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin rgyab dang mdun du ston par 'gyur bar gnyis bgrang ba'i nyi shu rtsa brgyad la byed dgos pas so/ /'o na sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo 'gyur/ zhes dang / de yi dbus su gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga rims par yongs su bgrang ba dag gi dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha ni mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes pas nyi shu rtsa lnga par bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/ ma yin no/ /mtha' ni zad dang 'jug cha dang / /zhes bshad pa'ang yod med kyi/ da lan zad pa la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na pad dkar gyi rjes khro bo bcu dang sems dpa' bcu bzhi spel nas lung bstan pas/

drag po 'khor lo can la lung bstan med pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ med pa ma grub ste/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan no/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur ba/ /rigs ldan grags pa de nyid slar/ /grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /'gyur khyad min zhes 'jam dbyangs sam grags pa nyid drag po 'khor lo can du bstan pas so/ /nyer lnga la mi gtogs na rigs ldan du mi 'thad do zhe na ma nges te/ 'khor lo can gyi kla klo bcom nas/ tshangs pa dang dbang po bdun rgyab tu chos ston pa'i tshang ba'i dus su mi lo stong brgya brgyar 'phel ba dang / de'i phyid ni 'od bsrung gi'o zhes sogs tshe lo rim gyis 'grib nas/ rdul gyi skye gnas brgyad po'i mthar yang rigs ldan du bshad pa'i phyir dang / rigs ldan mthar ni ji srid brgya phrag gcig gi lo yi grangs kyi skye bo rab tu 'gyur/ zhes bshad pas/ drag po byon ma thag tu kla klo 'joms pa'ang ma grub ste/ de ltar na byon ma thag tu bde ba'i gnas su gshegs par 'gyur te/ rdzogs ldan mtshams su kla klo'i chos rnams mtha' dag srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dag gis bcad byas nas/ /bcad nas lo ni brgya brgya rnams su tshangs pa bzhag pa mdzad nas bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na de'i sku tshad ni lo brgya yin par sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes pa'i rgyud tshig gis grub bo/ zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'dir rigs ldan nyer drug tu gsungs nas/ drag po'i sras tshangs pa dang dbang po bsnan pas nyer brgyad byung bar/ gsungs pa yin pa 'dra zhing / yang rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpag bsam snye ma las/ khyad par du rgyal po zla ba bzang po ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho thos ma thag byang shambha lar byon te/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa rgyud mtha' dag bsdus shing / yul dgu bcu rtsa drug po so so'i glegs bam du bris te/

rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyas 'grel stong phrag drug cu mdzad nas/ grong bye ba dgu cu rtsa drug na gnas pa'i skal ba ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur te legs par bstan pas/ de dag gis kyang mnyan cing bklags te rang gi sems la bzung nas gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu bstan te/ rgyud bstan pa'i lo gnyis pa la kā la pa'i grong gi phyogs ma la ya'i tshal gyi dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa shin tu che zhing yangs pa'i nang du/ rin po che sna lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ de nyid bcu drug rnam par dag pa lha drug brgya dang sum cu rtsa drug gi bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing rdzu 'phrul bstan nas sras sa'i snying po'i sprul pa lha dbang seṅge'i khri la chos ston pa por dbang bskur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku phyag na rdo rje nyid du gshegs so/ /rdo rje snying pos kyang kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa mdzad de rgyal sras rnams la bstan cing / lha dbang gis kyang lo brgya'i bar du rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa ston par mdzad de/ de nas lha dbang gi sras gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa gzi brjid can dang / de'i sras sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa zla bas byin dang / de'i sras khro bo rmugs byed kyi sprul pa lha'i dbang phyug dang / de'i sras rta mgrin gyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs dang / de'i sras nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha'i dbang ldan rnams kyis kyang / seṅge'i khri de la bzhugs lo brgya brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan te rang rang gi sras rgyal sar bzhag nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid du gshegs so/ /lha'i dbang ldan gyi btsun mo sna tshogs yum la sras bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa grags pa 'khrungs te/

de nar son pa na yab kyi rgyal sar bkos/ btsun mo lha mo sgrol ma khab tu bzhes pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku padma dkar po 'khrungs/ mi'i dbang po grags pa dbang phyug sems dpa'i khri la bzhugs te/ lo brgya'i bar du rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa rnams la bstan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung bstan pa'i stobs kyis kā la pa'i grong na gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams kyi don rgya chen po mdzad nas/ rigs ldan grags pa rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la thim mo/ /de nas rigs ldan padma dkar pos rgyas 'grel stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsnyen pa mdzad nas rgya cher spel te lo brgya rdzogs pa na/ rang gi sras khro bo mthar byed kyi sprul pa bzang po rgyal sar bzhag nas gshegs so/ des lo brgyar chos bstan cing de bzhin du sras brgyud pa snying gi sprul pa rnam rgyal dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa gshin rje bzang po dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa phyag dmar dang / khengs byed kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nam snying gi sprul pa nyi ma grags pa dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa shin tu bzang dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa rgyal dka' dang / sa snying gi sprul pa nyi ma dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa zla ba'i 'od/ khengs byed kyi sprul pa mtha' yas dang / nam snying gi sprul pa sa skyong dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa dpal skyong dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa seṅge/ gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa rnam par gnon pa dang / sa snying gi sprul pa stobs po che dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa ma 'gags pa dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa mi'i seṅge dang /

mkha' snying gi sprul pa dbang phyug chen po dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / de la sras 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can lha'i dbang po 'byung ste/ des kla klo bcom nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'god par mdzad nas slar shambha lar log ste/ sa dum bu 'di'i skye bo phal mo che rnams 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi lam la bgod par mdzad do/ /zhes rigs ldan nyer lngar bzhed cing / rigs ldan 'di la sras zung 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa lha'i dbang po dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa tshangs pa gnyis so/ /lha dbang ni lho gling nub mar byon nas de'i rigs brgyud kyis de na gnas pa'i kla klo rnams btul te sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'god par mdzad la/ de nas rim gyis dum bu bcu po rnams su yang / de'i rigs brgyud las byung ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du kla klo rnams 'joms par mdzad do/ /rigs ldan drag pos rgyal sar lo brgya rdzogs pa na sras tshangs pa rgyal sar bkos te rang nyid bde ba chen po'i gnas su gshegs par mdzad do/ /ces sogs gsungs 'dug la/ yang jo nang phyogs la rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar rtogs brjod las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i lo gnyis pa las/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos rtsa rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel pa stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad nas shambha la la sogs pa'i yul gyi mi rnams la bstan/ de nas lha'i dbang po dang / gzi brjid can dang / zla bas byin dang / lha'i dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha'i dbang ldan rnams kyis lo brgya brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan to/ /de nas 'jam dpal grags pas kyang lo brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan nas/ de'i rjes su nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pas drang srong rnams kyi gsol ba btab nas bsdus pa'i rgyud 'phreng 'dzin gyi tshig bcad stong sum cu pa 'di rtsa ba'i rgyud las byung ste bsdu bar mdzad do/

/de nas 'jam dbyangs grags pas spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa padma dkar po la bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di ston cing rgya 'grel rtsom par bkos te mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas padma dkar pos rgya 'grel stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od mdzad cing chos bstan to/ /de nas bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / gshin rje bzang po dang / rin chen phyag dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags dang / shin tu bzang po ste brgyad pos lo brgya brgyar chos bstan cing / de nas rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka' gnyis kyis lo bzhi brgya dang gsum gyi bar du chos bstan to/ /de nas nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang / dpal skyong dang / seṅge dang / rnam snon dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gags pa dang / mi'i seṅge dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / 'khor lo can rigs ldan drag po ste bcu gnyis pos kyang lo brgya brgyar chos bstan cing / drag pos kla klo 'joms par mdzad do/ /zhes rigs ldan nyer lngar bzhed cing / 'di la kha cig mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gnyis su bgrangs nas rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug yin no zhes 'chad pa dang / bla ma bi bhu ta tsand+ra ni/ seṅge rnam gnon gnyis gcig mtha' yas rnam rgyal gnyis gcig tu byas nas mjug gi grags pa dang drag po tha dad du byas nas rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngar bzhed ces kyang gsung ngo / /yang ratna ma ti'i ngo mtshar rtogs brjod las/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho thos ma thag byang shambha lar byon te mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa rgyud mtha' dag bsdus shing / yul dgu bcu rtsa drug so so'i skad kyis glegs bam du bris te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgya 'grel stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad nas/ grong bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur ste legs par bstan pas/

de dag gis kyang mnyan cing bklags te rang gi sems la bzung nas gzhan dag la yang rgya cher rab tu bstan to/ /rgyud bstan pa'i lo gnyis pa la kā la pa'i grong gi lho phyogs ma la ya'i tshal gyi dbus rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa shin tu che zhing yangs pa'i nang du/ rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ de nyid bcu drug rnam par dag pa lha drug brgya dang sum cu rtsa drug gi bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing rdzu 'phrul bstan nas/ sras sa'i snying po'i sprul pa lha dbang seṅge'i khri la chos ston pa por dbang bskur te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku phyag na rdo rje nyid du gshegs so/ /lha dbang gis kyang lo brgya'i bar du rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa ston par mdzad de/ de nas lha dbang gi sras gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa gzi brjid can dang / de'i sras sgrib pa rnam sel kyi sprul pa zla bas byin dang / de'i sras khro bo rmugs byed kyi sprul pa lha'i dbang phyug dang / de'i sras rta mgrin gyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs dang / de'i sras nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha'i dbang phyug rnams kyis seṅge'i khri la bzhugs nas lo brgya brgyar rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan te rang rang gi sras rgyal sar bzhag nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid du gshegs so/ /lha'i dbang ldan gyi btsun mo sna tshogs yum la sras bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i sku grags pa 'khrungs te/ de nar son pa na yab kyis rgyal sar bkos/ btsun mo lha mo sgrol ma khab tu bzhes pa la sras 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa padma dkar po 'khrungs/ mi'i dbang po grags pa byang chub sems dpa'i seṅge'i khri de la bzhugs te lo brgya'i bar du rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa snod ldan rnams la bstan nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung bstan pa'i stobs kyis kā la pa'i grong na gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi yongs su smin pas yang dag pa'i lam la thob par mdzad nas/ de nas sras padma dkar po la rgyud gtad de rgyal sar bskos nas thog mar bsdus pa'i rgyud glegs bam du 'bri ba dang / rgyas 'grel rtsom la bsngags pa rnams la bstan te rgyas par gyis shig ces rjes su gnang ba stsal/ gzhan yang steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ces sogs dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha rnams la 'jig rten bsrung zhig pa brjod de/ rigs ldan grags pa rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la thim mo/ de nas rigs ldan padma dkar pos rgyas 'grel stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsnyen pa mdzad nas rgya cher spel te lo brgya rdzogs pa na/ rang gi sras khro bo gshin rje mthar byed sprul pa bzang po rgyal sar bzhag nas gshegs so/ /des lo brgyar chos bstan cing / de bzhin du sras brgyud sa snying gi sprul pa rnam rgyal dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa bshes gnyen bzang po dang / sgrib sel kyi sprul pa phyag dmar dang / khengs byed kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / sa snying gi sprul pa nyi ma grags dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa shin tu bzang dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa rgyal dka' dang / sa snying gi sprul pa nyi ma dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa zla ba'i 'od dang / khengs byed kyi sprul pa mtha' yas dang / nam mkha' snying gi sprul pa sa skyong dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa dpal skyong dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa seṅge dang / gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa rnam par gnon pa dang / sa snying gi sprul pa stobs po che dang /

rmugs byed kyi sprul pa ma 'gags pa dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa mi'i seṅge dang / nam snying gi sprul pa dbang phyug chen po dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / de'i sras 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can lha'i dbang po 'byung ste/ des kla klo bcom nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'god par mdzad do/ /rigs ldan 'di la sras zung 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa lha'i dbang po dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa tshangs pa gnyis so/ /lha dbang ni lho gling nub mar byon nas de'i rigs brgyud kyis de na gnas pa'i kla klo rnams btul te sangs rgyas kyi chos la 'god par mdzad la/ de nas rim gyis dum bu bcu po rnams su yang de'i rigs brgyud las byung ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du kla klo 'joms par mdzad do/ /rigs ldan drag pos rgyal sa lo brgya rdzogs pa na sras tshangs pa rgyal sar bskos te rang nyid bde ba chen po'i gnas su gshegs par mdzad do zhes rigs ldan nyer lnga dang / drag po'i sras gnyis 'byung bar gsungs 'dug la/ yang padma dkar po gnyis pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba thams cad bshad pa'i mdzod ces pas 'brug lugs la/ 'grel chen las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa yang shambha la la sogs pa'i yul gyi skad gzhan gyis glegs bam la bris nas/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos grong bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug na gnas pa rnams la rab tu bstan to/ /rgyud bstan pa'i slad dus de nas lo gnyis pa la sems can rnams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyu'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang rdzu 'phrul bstan nas sprul pa'i sku yis gang nas byon pa de nyid du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yis gshegs so zhes zhu ba po rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od yin pa'i phyir zla ba bzang po des bsdus te 'grel bshad stong phrag bcu pa mdzad/

ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i blo blangs bzhengs pa'i rgyud bstan pa'i dus de nas/ lo gnyis pa de nyid la sras lha'i dbang po la rgyal srid gtad de gshegs so/ /gang du gshegs na gang nas byon pa der zhes pa lcang lo can nam ro ldan zhes pa'i ming can ri rab kyi rtse'i char yod pa der byon pa te/ ro ldan na gnas pa gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyi bdag po'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /nang du ro ldan ni chos kyi sprin gyi sar bzhag pas der byon pa'o/ /'di yang drang ba'i don te/ thub pa gangs can mtsho zhes pa'i rgyal tshab kun tu bzang po de/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar byed pa'i phyir gnod sbyin rnams kyi bdag po nor bu bzang po zhes bya bar sprul pa de yin la/ nges pa'i don la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi nus pa'o/ /gzhan yang rna ba'i dag pa phyag na rdo rjer bshad pas kyang ngo / /rgyal po des kyang shambha lar gnas pa thams cad la bstan pa ni ma yin te/ de nyid la mos pa zhes dgar tshig gis bstan pa dang / de bzhin lhag ma drug gis kyang ste/ grags pa thams cad rigs cig tu byed par bshad pa'i rigs so/ /de nas rgyud 'dir drang srong rigs sogs la/ /sangs rgyas lam ni gsal byed pa/ /zla ba lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bas byin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha dbang ldan/ /zhes dang / 'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ /phyag na rdo rje zla bzang khyod/ /sa snying gshin rje mthar byed dang / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel/ /rmugs byed khengs byed rim pa ste/ /nam mkha'i snying po'o zhes gsungs pas/ /rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od ces bya zla bzang gi yum de bgegs mthar byed kyi sprul par bstan kyang / seṅge'i khri la bzhugs te chos ston pa po ni ma yin no/

/zla ba bzang po bshad zin/ de'i sras sa'i snying po'i sprul pa lha dbang / de'i sras gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa gzi brjid can/ de'i sras sgrib sel gyi sprul pa zla bas byin/ de'i sras khro bo rmugs byed kyi sprul pa lha'i dbang phyug de'i sras rta mgrin nam khengs byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs/ de'i sras nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha'i dbang ldan te/ 'di drug ni rtsa ba'i rgyud dang 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa la 'chad nyan mdzad mkhan grags pa pad dkar rim pas so/ /zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs dang / 'jig rten mgon po go rim bzhin/ rgyal po 'jam dbyangs grags pas bsdus pa'i rgyud lan gnyis bstan te/ gang gi sras lha mo sgrol ma'i mngal du 'khrungs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug padma dkar po la rgyal srid gtad cing / des bsdus pa'i rgyud la bstan pa'i lung bstan ji lta bar 'grel bshad rtsom par bskul lo lung bstan/ 'di yi sgrol ma lha mo che/ /sras ni pad 'dzin 'jig rten dbang / /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal po de thams cad shākya'i rigs te/ bdag gi shākya'i rigs brgyud la/ /byung ba zla bzang khyod rigs la'o/ /zhes dang / 'grel bshad byed pa pad dkar 'dzin/ /zhes pas so/ /bzang po rigs ldan gsum pa ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /gshin rje bzang po phyag dmar sna/ /bdun pa khyab 'jug sbas pa'o/ /nyi ma grags dang shin du bzang / /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' dang / /rigs ldan nyi ma bcu gnyis pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla ba'i 'od/ /mtha' yas dang ni sa skyong dang / /dpal skyong seṅge rnam par gnon/ /stobs po che dang ma 'gags pa/ /mi yi seṅge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /zhes pa'i bar/ gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /de bar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan/ /bcu gsum de dag rim pa yis/ /rigs ldan rigs las 'byung bar 'gyur/

/zhes dang po khro bo mthar byed dang / khro bo'i bar du byang sems 'byung ba tsam gsungs pa la brten nas/ padma dkar po'i sras gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa bzang po dang / de'i sras sa snying gi sprul pa rnam rgyal dang / de'i sras rmugs byed kyi sprul pa gshin rje bzang po dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa phyag dmar dang / khengs byed kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nam snying gi sprul pa nyi ma grags dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa shin tu bzang po dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang / gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa rgyal dka' dang / sa snying gi sprul pa nyi ma dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa zla ba'i 'od dang / khengs byed kyi sprul pa mtha' yas dang / nam snying gi sprul pa sa skyong dang / bgegs dgra'i sprul pa dpal skyong dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa seṅge dang / gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa rnam gnon dang / sa snying gi sprul pa stobs po che dang / rmugs byed kyi sprul pa ma 'gags pa dang / sgrib sel gyi sprul pa mi'i seṅge dang / mkha' snying gi sprul pa dbang phyug chen po dang / phyag rdor gyi sprul pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal zhes 'don pa dang / thar lo sa snying bzang por byed pa sogs sprul gzhi gang dang sprul pa de'i ngos 'dzin mi mthun pa mang ste/ lung gis dngos su ma sbyar ba'i skyon yin no/ /grangs kyang 'ga' zhig rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngar 'chad la/ de ltar sngar gyi lung don dang / /'grel chen las/ de bzhin rim pa ji lta bar gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa khro bo bcu dang / sa'i snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bcu bzhi po rnams te gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyal po de dag gi bar du byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po de dag lung bstan to zhes pad dkar nas drag po 'khor lo can gyi bar la nyer gsum du bshad pa mi 'grig pas/

rang lugs mtha' yas rnam rgyal so so bas sa snying gi sprul pa rnam rgyal zhes 'don no/ /de nas/ de yi dbus su gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lngar rim par yongs su bgrangs pa dmag gis dus kyi mthar/ zhes rigs ldan grags pa'i gdan rab nyi shu rtsa lnga rdzogs pa'i mthar drag po 'khor lo can 'byung bar gsungs pas kyang shes par bya'o/ /bi bhu ti dpal skyong dang seṅge gcig tu bsdu/ mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gcig tu bsdus te/ de'i rjes la grags pa zhes bgrangs/ de nas drag po 'dod pa ni nor ba'o zhes gsungs pa la 'khrul par snang bas so/ /lung 'dir ni/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa slar rnam rgyal gyi sras po drag po 'khor lo can du 'khrungs par lung bstan pa ste/ yang dag theg par mngon 'dzegs lha min rigs la 'jigs ster dpal ldan grags pa phyag na mdung thung can/ /sems can rnams la thar pa'i slad du sa la dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pas so/ /'di phyag rdor gyi sprul par bshad pa nor ba'o/ /'ga' zhig grags pas rtsa rgyud lo brgya bstan/ bsdus rgyud lo brgya bstan la/ gzhan rnams kyis lo drug cu drug cur chos bstan par 'dod pa dang phyogs pa sogs/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi dus brgya gya gnyis dang / rgyal dka'i dus gnyis brgya nyer gcig tu 'dod pa dang / phal cher rigs ldan rnams kyi sku tshe'i tshad lo brgyar 'dod pa ni ma dag pa ste/ 'grel chen las/ de nas lha dbang gi lo brgya'i bar du rgyud ston par mdzad de/ de bzhin du gzi brjid can zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i seṅge'i khri de la lo brgya'i bar du chos bstan to/ /zhes pa dang / de nas klu'i lo brgya rnams kyi/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal dka'i bar gyi lo grangs lung las ches gsal ba dang / mtha' ma drag po la yang / sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo bsgyur zhes pa'i gdan yang chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs bdun rigs ldan grags pa nas rnam rgyal gyi bar nyer lngas so gnyis po tshe lo brgya pa zhes pa'ang /

mi lo brgyar zhes pa'i don du'o/ /rigs ldan nyer drug pa 'di rang 'byon pa'i dus ni rtsod dus yin te/ /gang du chos ni rnam par nyams shing rtsod dus 'jug pa de dang der ni rab tu 'jug par byed/ /kla klo rnams kyang g.yul du bcom te rang gi chos la 'god par byas nas mdun du rnam par rgyu/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dag dang rtsod dus gzhan ni dus kyi sbyor ba dag gis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dum bu gang du stobs ldan 'khor lo can de rab tu zhugs pa der ni rdzogs ldan dus bsgrod de/ /rgyal po'i rgyab tu gsum ldan rtsod pa'i dus kyang mdun dag tu ste gnyis kyi bar du gnyis ldan no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mdun zhes pa rang gi dus dang / rgyab ces pa'i don no/ /des na dus bzhi la skal pa'i dus bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dus bzhi/ gza' rnams kyi longs spyod rags pa'i tshad kyi stong par 'jug pa'i lo grangs mi lo sa ya bzhi/ 'bum phrag gsum nyi khri dang bcas pa la dus bzhi chen po dang / dus bzhi chung ngu rigs ldan gyi dus bzhi ste rgyas par gsungs pa rnams yi ger 'jigs nas 'dir ma bkod la zhes gsungs la/ yang dus phyis byon pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ oṃ swasti/ bla med brgyud pa kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa'i srol/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa khyed cig gzhan smra rnams/ /chu shing bzhin du snying pos dben mthong nas/ /'jam dbyangs sa lo'i bzhed gzhung seṅge'i sgras/ /'khrul 'jam wa skyes nga ro tshar bcad de/ /rdo rje'i rgya ldan rgyud don zab mo'i gnad/ /legs par dbye 'o mkhas rnams gus pas nyon/ /zhes rtsom par dam bca' sngon du btang nas/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/

/de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal pos kla klo kun bcom nas/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi bar du yang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa spel bar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di'i don/ chos kyi rje nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin 'chad shes pa'i mkhas pa/ chos kyi rje mya ngan las 'das pa nas bzung ste/ deng sang gi bar du cung zad kyang ma byung bar/ rang rang gi rtog pas btags pa'i 'chad tshul phyin ci log tu gyur pa du ma zhig byung ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis/ de tshe 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /zhes gzhung bcos nas 'don pa dang / yang gzhan dag gis/ sa skya paṇḍi tas dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul la legs par ma sbyangs pa'o zhes smra ba sogs 'khrul pa'i gtam de dag tshar bcad pa dang / chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par gsal ba'i phyir/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag cung zad 'chad pa la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / 'grel mdzad snga ma'i bzhed srol la dpyad pa dang / rang lugs 'khrul pa med pa'i gnad bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la rigs ldan gyi grangs bshad pa dang / mtshan bshad pa dang / gang gi sprul pa gang yin la dpyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ spyir rgyal po zla bzang gi yab chos rgyal nyi ma'i 'od bgrang na chos rgyal brgyad du 'byed pa yin te/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rgyud 'dir drang srong rigs sogs la/ /sangs rgyas lam ni gsal byed pa/ /zla ba lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bas byin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lhan gcig ldan/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / nyi ma'i 'od dang chos rgyal yin pa yang / /'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang sdom du byas na/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang / /gzi brjid zlas byin lha'i dbang phyug dang /

sna tshogs gzugs dang lha'i dbang ldan ste/ /chos rgyal chen po brgyad ni de ltar nges/ /zhes pa 'di lta bu gcig thob pa yin no/ /yang nyi ma'i 'od ni/ shākya sham ka zhes bya ba shākya'i rigs rgyud kyi rgyal po zhig yin la/ de nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ma thos shing / de'i sras rgyal po zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud thob pas na/ zla bzang nas chos rgyal gyi mgo bzung ba'i tshe chos rgyal bdun zhes pa'i tha snyad thob pa yin te/ bsdus rgyud las/ dpal ldan shākya'i rigs la rab gsal ma'i dbang po bdun te zhes gsungs pas so/ /chos rgyal lha'i dbang ldan gyi sras rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pa man chad la rigs ldan gyi ming thob pa yin te/ 'jam dpal grags pas shambha la'i yul gyi rigs tha dad pa thams cad rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu byin gyis rlabs pas na/ rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pa man chad la rigs ldan gyi ming thob pa yin cing / rigs ldan gyi thog mar 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ bsdus pa'i rgyud la/ brgyad pa dpal ldan grags pa yang / /'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha yi mchog gis btud pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rigs ldan te/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin nas mtha' dag thub pa'i rigs rnams dag ni rigs gcig dag tu byed par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rigs ldan gyi grangs la yang dus 'khor ba snga ma kha cig rigs ldan nyer drug dang nyer bdun sogs su bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ drag po 'khor lo can rigs ldan nyer lnga par gsungs nas/ de'i rjes la rigs ldan gzhan ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / bsdus rgyud las/ gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrang pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha yis mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/

/zhes gsal bar gsungs pas so/ /rigs ldan nyer drug tu 'dod pa kha cig gis/ gzhung 'di la 'bru bsnon khyer/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga mthar rtsa drug pa drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zer ba'ang thos mod/ de ni rmongs pa te/ de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ /zhes nyi shu rtsa lnga po de'i nang nas tha mar drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes gsal bar gsungs bzhin du/ de las go bzlog ste/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa las logs su rtsa drug par drag po 'khor lo can khyed kyi ngos bzung 'dug pas so/ /rig pa 'di'i don sems par gyis la da phyin chad 'di 'dra'i kha 'chal ma gleng zhig de nas rang gi lugs ni/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngar grangs nges pa yin te/ rigs ldan nyer lnga'i steng du sngar gyi chos rgyal bdun bsnan nas/ rim bzhin bgrang ba'i so gnyis pa drag po 'khor lo can yin pa'i phyir te/ bsdus rgyud las/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rigs ldan nyer lngar grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /de bar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan/ /bcu gsum de rnams rim pa yis/ /rigs ldan rigs la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes khro bo'i sprul pa bcu dang / byang sems kyi sprul pa bcu gsum ste nyer gsum/ de'i sngon du 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa rigs ldan grags pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa rigs ldan pad dkar gnyis te nyer lnga gsal bar gsungs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i sprul gzhi dang sprul pa gang yang ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag dang mthun par/ rje btsun rin po che 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rigs ldan 'khor tshul gyi yi ge las kyang / kalki grags pa zhes bya dang / /kalki pad dkar gnyis pa ste/

/kalki bzang po gsum pa'o/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /shes bzang rin chen dmar po'i phyag /khyab 'jug sbas pa bdun pa ste/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang / /rgya mtsho'i nyi ma rnam rgyal dang / /kalki nyi ma bcu gnyis dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla ba'i 'od/ /mtha' yas dang ni sa skyong dang / /dpal skyong dang ni seṅge gnon/ /ngo mtshar che dang 'gag med dang / /mi yi seṅge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal grags pa che/ /de yis sras ni 'khor lo can/ /drag po kalki 'byung 'gyur bas/ /kla klo'i chos ni mthar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa 'di yis rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i grangs phyin ci ma log par bstan pa yin pas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa rje btsun gong mas bkral ba bzhin khas len par 'dod pa dag yod na 'di shin tu nges par bya dgos so/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rigs ldan so so'i mtshan ngos bzung ba la/ jo nang pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams/ seṅge rnam gnon mtshan dum bur bcad de/ rigs ldan seṅge dang / rigs ldan rnam gnon zhes gnyis su 'dren pa dang / bu ston rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams/ seṅge rnam gnon gcig tu bgrangs nas mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi mtshan dum bur bcad de/ rigs ldan mtha' yas dang / rigs ldan rnam rgyal zhes gnyis su 'dren pa dang / dus 'khor ba gzhan 'ga' dag de gnyis char gyi mtshan dum bur bcad de rigs nyer drug dang nyer bdun sogs su 'dod pa ni/ gzhung don la gtan nas ma bzhugs pa te/ de ltar du 'byed rgyu yin na/ 'jam dpal grags pa zhes pa'i 'jam dpal dang grags pa gnyis kyang so sor 'byed dgos par thal ba dang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal zhes pa'i rgya mtsho dang rnam rgyal gnyis kyang so sor 'dren dgos pa sogs thug med thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi rigs ldan gyi mtshan 'dren lugs de 'dra ni/ sngon gyi dus 'khor ba chen po tsa lu paṇḍi ta dang /

lo tsā ba ra 'bro tsa gsum la sogs pas mdzad pa'i yig cha khungs ma rnams na gtan nas med cing / khungs dang ma 'brel ba'i sgro btags kyi bshad pa la mkhas pa rnams ngo mtshar du mi rtsi bas rgyang ring du dor bar bya dgos la/ 'o na khyed rang gi lugs la rigs ldan rnams kyi mtshan ji ltar snyam na/ de la gnyis/ bshad gzhi'i lung drangs pa dang / lung don gtan la phab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ /grags pa rigs ldan rigs kyang ste/ /de nas rigs ldan padma dkar/ /bzang po rigs ldan gsum pa ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa rnam rgyal lo/ /bshes gnyen bzang po rin chen phyag /bdun pa khyab 'jug sbas pa'o/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang / /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' dang / /rigs ldan nyi ma bcu gnyis pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /mtha' yas dang ni sa skyong dang / /dpal skyong seṅge rnam par gnon/ /stobs po che dang ma 'gag pa/ /mi yi seṅge dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur ste/ /smra mkhas rta mchog ting 'dzin gyis/ /kla klo'i chos ni mthar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di shong 'gyur sogs 'gyur phal cher du 'di kho na ltar 'byung la/ gyi jo 'gyur dang rma 'gyur sogs su gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /zhes pa'i mtshams su/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas yang / /de yi bu ni 'khor lo can/ /rigs ldan drag po 'byung 'gyur te/ /zhes bshad cing / 'di gnyis la tshig zhe sa sbyar ma sbyar tsam ma gtogs/ don la khyad med na yang / 'gyur phyi ma 'di'i dngos kyi tshig rigs la/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi sras su rigs ldan grags pa zhes pa gcig 'byung / grags pa'i sras su rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes pa gcig gsal bar thon pas na/

mjug gi rigs ldan grags pa dang drag po tha dad du byed pa/ bla ma bi bhu ta tsant+ra'i rgya dpe la yang yod ces dus 'khor ba tshad ldan rnams la yongs su grags zhing / jo nang phyogs las rnams rgyal gyi 'grel chen la 'jug pa dang / rigs ldan khor tshul gnyis char du/ /paṇḍi ta bi bhu ta tsant+ra ni seṅge rnam gnon gcig tu byas nas/ mjug gi grags pa dang drag po tha dad du bzhed do zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun zhing / bi bhu ta tsant+ra bzhed par ma zad/ kha che'i mkhan po paṇa chen shākya shrī yang bzhed pa yin la/ lugs de dag dang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rigs ldan 'khor tshul gyi yi ge dang / 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi tas sdom gsum rab dbyer gsungs pa rnams 'chad tshul gang rung 'grig pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa lung don gtan la dbab pa la/ rigs ldan so so'i mtshan go rim bzhin du bshad pa dang / mjug gi rigs ldan grags pa dang / rigs ldan drag po gnyis thugs rgyud tha dad par byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mtshan ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul yod de/ rigs ldan dang po 'jam dpal grags pa/ rigs ldan gnyis pa padma dkar po/ rigs ldan gsum pa bzang po/ rigs ldan bzhi pa rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan lnga pa bshes gnyen bzang po/ rigs ldan drug pa rin chen phyag ste phyag dmar/ rigs ldan bdun pa khyab 'jug sbas pa/ rigs ldan brgyad pa nyi ma grags pa/ rigs ldan dgu pa shin tu bzang po/ rigs ldan bcu pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan bcu gcig pa rgyal dka'/ rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa nyi ma/ rigs ldan bcu gsum pa sna tshogs gzugs/ rigs ldan bcu bzhi pa zla ba'i 'od/ rigs ldan bcwo lnga pa mtha' yas/ rigs ldan bcu drug pa sa skyong / rigs ldan bcu bdun pa dpal skyong / rigs ldan bcwo brgyad pa seṅge rnam gnon/ rigs ldan bcu dgu pa stobs po che/

rigs ldan nyi shu pa ma 'gags pa/ rigs ldan nyer gcig pa mi yi seṅge/ rigs ldan nyer gnyis pa dbang phyug chen po/ rigs ldan nyer gsum pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan nyer bzhi pa grags pa can/ rigs ldan nyer lnga pa drag po 'khor lo can ste/ de ltar nyer lngar ngos 'dzin pa 'di rgyud dang / rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa bla na med pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa/ mjug gi rigs ldan grags pa dang / /rigs ldan drag po gnyis thugs rgyud tha dad du byed pa'i rgyu mtshan 'chad pa la/ 'dir skabs kyi grags pa dang / drag po gnyis rgyud tha dad par byed dgos te/ rgyud rang gi dngos bstan la/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal rigs ldan dang / /grags pa rigs ldan zhes grags pa rigs ldan gyi rjes su/ rigs ldan grags pa zhes pa gcig smyon med du gsungs shing / de nas slar zhes pa dang / de nas yang zhes pa dang / de'i rjes su zhes pa dang / de ma thag par zhes pa rnams don gyi go ba gcig cing tha snyad go rim ston pa'i tshig tu mtshungs pas/ rigs ldan grags pa zer ba'i rjes su su 'dra zhig 'byung snyam na/ de'i rjes de ma thag par/ grags pa de'i drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes pa'i don yin par dpyod ldan rnam dpyod yod pa zhig gi bltas na mngon sum nyid du gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de las gzhan du khyed 'dod pa ltar/ grags pa rigs ldan zhes pa rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa la bzhag nas/ de slar yang drag po 'khor lo can du 'gyur ro zhes khas len pa la rnam dpyad ci yang ma byung ste/ de ltar na rigs ldan grags pa'i skye ba yin pa'i rigs ldan du ma zhig de'i snga rol du yang yong bas na/ de dag gi skabs su nges par smos mi dgos par/ 'di kho na la ched du smos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi rjes de ma thag par drag po 'khor lo can 'byung rgyu yin na/

grags pa 'das byon 'khor lo can/ /zhes pa gcig 'byung srid kyis/ /grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi de nas zhes pa'i nye tshig 'byung ba la 'brel med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang drag po 'khor lo can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par 'chad dgos kyi/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par byas pa la 'brel ci yang med de/ khyed kyi 'dod pa ltar na/ drag po 'khor lo can 'jam dbyangs yin la/ de'i sras tshangs pa ni 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par nang le'i 'grel chen nyid las gsungs pas na/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sras su 'jam dbyangs nyid 'byung ba tha snyad cung zad mi mdzes shing / don la yang dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na nang le'i 'grel par 'khor lo can gyi sras tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs yin par ji ltar bshad na/ de nyid las phyi rol du 'khor lo can gyi sras tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang por gyur pa rgyab kyi dum bu gcig tu chos ston par byed pa dang / mdun te mdun gyi dum bur kla klo'i chos zad pa don du gnyer ba gang yin pa/ 'jam dpal dang / 'jig rten mgon srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba de ni/ zhes gsal bar gsungs so/ /'di yang gnad kyi dam pa'o/ /des na/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi grags pa rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa la ngos 'dzin pa na/ gsung rab khungs ma dang ma 'brel bar/ rang bzo'i dgongs dpyad chen po zhig yin pa la/ skyo ma snga btsan gyi tshig rjes su zhugs pas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis drag po 'khor lo can phyag rdor gyi sprul par bshad pa ni mkhas pa'i gtam ma yin no zhes gnad ma rtogs par rang rang gi de nyid ston pa mang du yod pas/ de dag gis kyang kho bos legs par bshad pa 'di la nan tan du blta bar byos la sems rnal du phob cig rtsa ba'i gsum pa gang gi sprul pa gang yin pa dpyad pa la/ rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od nas/ rigs ldan pad dkar gyi bar gyi sprul gzhi ngos bzung ba dang /

rigs ldan bzang po nas drag po 'khor lo can gyi bar gyi rigs ldan nyer gsum so so'i sprul gzhi ngos bzung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bshad gzhi lung drangs pa dang / lung don gtan la phab pa gnyis/ /dang po ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bas byin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha'i dbang ldan/ /grags pa pad dkar rim pas so/ /'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ /phyag na rdo rje zla bzang khyod/ /sa snying bshes gnyen mthar byed dang / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel dang / /rmugs byed khengs byed rim pas ste/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug go rim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs dang / gnyis pa de'i don gtan la dbab pa ni/ rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od nas rigs ldan pad dkar gyi bar rnams so so'i sprul gzhi ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul yod de/ chos rgyal dang po nyi ma'i 'od khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sprul pa/ chos rgyal gnyis pa zla ba bzang po phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa/ chos rgyal gsum pa lha dbang sa'i snying po'i sprul pa/ chos rgyal bzhi pa gzi brjid can gshin rje mthar byed gyi sprul pa/ chos rgyal lnga pa zla bas byin sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa/ chos rgyal drug pa lha'i dbang phyug khro bo rmugs byed kyi sprul pa/ chos rgyal bdun pa sna tshogs gzugs khro bo 'khengs byed kyi sprul pa/ chos rgyal brgyad pa lha'i dbang ldan nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa/ rigs ldan dang po 'jam dpal grags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa/ rigs ldan gnyis pa padma dkar po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de na nyi ma'i 'od nas bzung ste rigs ldan pad dkar gyi bar gyi sprul gzhi ni/ rgyud nyid las dngos bstan shin tu gsal ba'i dbang gis/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i srol 'dzin pa thams cad kyang /

de dag gi sprul gzhi'i ngos 'dzin zhal mthun pa kho na 'byung ba yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rigs ldan bzang po nas drag po 'khor lo can gyi bar gyi sprul gzhi ngos bzung ba las/ bshad gzhi'i lung drangs ba dang / lung don gtan la dbab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /de bar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan/ /bcu gsum de rnams rim pa yis/ /rigs ldan rigs la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen las/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa khro bo bcu po rnams kyi bar bar du/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po rnams lung bstan pa zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de'i don 'chad pa la/ gzhung gi tshig 'bru bsnan pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ sprul gzhi dang sprul pa sbyar ba'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs ldan bzang po man chad rigs ldan so so'i sprul gzhi dang sprul pa ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul yod de/ gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo'i sprul pa bcu dang / de dag gi bar du khro bo las gzhan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa bcu po rnams/ gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa dmigs gsal 'bur dod du byas/ gzhan rnams sngar rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od nas/ rigs ldan pad dkar gyi sprul gzhi'i bar go rim nges par can du bshad zin pa'i rim pa de yis ni rigs ldan gyi rigs la 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sprul gzhi dang sprul pa sbyar ba'i sgo rgyas par bshad pa la/ rang lugs gzhag pa dang / gzhan lugs la dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs ldan gsum pa bzang po de khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi sprul par 'jog pa yin te/ 'grel chen las/ bdag gi phyi nas gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa lung bstan to/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud rang las kyang / gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /zhes gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa thog mar smos 'dug pas so/

/rigs ldan bzhi pa rnam rgyal man chad kyi sprul gzhi la 'grel tshad rnams kyis lung rigs dang bral ba'i gtam zang zing po mang po zhig snang yang / 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo'i dgongs pas/ rtsa rgyud las/ de rnams rim pa yis so zhes pa'i skabs kyis rim pa de/ /sngar chos rgyal brgyad dang / rigs ldan gnyis kyi sprul gzhi'i skabs kyi khro bo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skabs kyi go rim la 'jog par smyon med du grub cing / sprul gzhi de dag gi go rim yang khro bo bgegs mthar byed phyag na rdo rje/ sa'i snying po/ gshin rje mthar byed/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ khro bo rmugs byed/ khro bo khengs byed/ nam mkha'i snying po/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ste go rim de ltar du rtsa rgyud nyid las gsal bar gsungs pas na/ go rim de nyid kyis/ rigs ldan bzhi pa rnam rgyal nas/ /nyer lnga pa drag po 'khor lo can gyi bar gyi sprul gzhi rnams phyin ci log par 'chad dgos pa yin zhing / de ltar bshad pa'i tshe/ sprul gzhi'i skor mgo re'i mjug tu/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gsum re sbrel mar 'byung ba 'di nyid spyir gzhung don dang / khyad par rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos kyi rje nyid kyi dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin te/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i rigs ldan 'khor tshul gyi yi ge las/ gshin rje rtsod pa rnams nas phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ drag po kalki zhes pa'i bar/ /khro bo bcu dang de bzhin du/ /byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum sbyar/ /mjug tu byang chub sems dpa' gsum/ /rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa 'di la dpyod ldan chos kyi las 'phro yod pa zhig gis bltas na mngon sum du gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de dag kyang go rim ji lta ba bzhin du bshad na/ rigs ldan bzang po man chad kyis sprul gzhi ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul yod de/

rigs ldan gsum pa bzang po gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa/ rigs ldan bzhi pa rnam rgyal bgegs bskor mgo mthar byed kyi sprul pa/ rigs ldan lnga pa bshes gnyen bzang po phyag rdor gyi sprul pa/ drug pa phyag dmar sa'i snying po'i sprul pa/ bdun pa khyab 'jug sbas pa gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa/ brgyad pa nyi ma grags sgrib pa rnam pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa/ dgu pa shin tu bzang po rmugs byed kyi sprul pa/ bcu pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khengs byed kyi sprul pa/ bcu gcig pa rgyal dka' nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa/ bcu gnyis pa nyi ma 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa/ bcu gsum pa sna tshogs gzugs spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa/ bcu bzhi pa zla 'od bgegs mthar byed kyi sprul pa/ bcwo lnga pa mtha' yas phyag rdor gyi sprul pa/ bcu drug pa sa skyong sa snying gi sprul pa/ bcu bdun pa dpal skyong gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa/ bcwo brgyad pa seṅge rnam gnon sgrib sel gyi sprul pa/ bcu dgu pa stobs po che rmugs byed kyi sprul pa/ nyi shu pa ma 'gags pa khengs byed kyi sprul pa/ nyer gcig pa mi'i seṅge nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa/ nyer gnyis pa dbang phyug chen po 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa/ nyer gsum pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa/ nyer bzhi pa grags pa bgegs yang bskor mgo mthar byed kyi sprul pa/ nyer lnga pa drag po 'khor lo can phyag rdor gyi sprul pa ste/ de ltar du ngos 'dzin pa 'di rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bskor ba'i re re'i mjug tu nam mkha'i snying po/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gsum re sbrel mar 'byung bas/ rje btsun gyis/ mjug tu byang chub sems dpa' gsum/ /rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/

/gnyis pa gzhan gyi lugs la dpyad pa ni/ bu dol gnyis sogs dus 'khor ba phal cher gyis/ rigs ldan bzhi pa rnams rgyal man chad kyi sprul gzhi la/ rang rang gi dgongs dpyad kyi bshad pa la ma gtogs/ lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun pa zhig ma byung na/ dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ sa skya pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can gyi dgongs pa yin gsungs ba'i rigs ldan 'khor tshul yang mthong mod kyi/ de yang drag po 'khor lo can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa dang nam 'grig 'grig sbyar ba zhig ma gtogs/ don dang mthun pa'i lung rigs rnam dag yod pa ma mthong zhing / gzhan deng sang gi mkhas par rlom pa phal che ba zhig la ni 'di'i thad la ni tshig sbrel nas lab rgyu tsam yang mi snang la/ cung zad smra rgyu yod khul rnams la skyo ma snga btsan dang / ri bong cal gyi bshad pa ma gtogs rgyud don dang mthun pa cung zad kyang mi snang bas/ deng phyin chad mkhas pa dpyod ldan rnams kyis kho bos bshad pa 'di la zhib tu dpyad pa gyis la snying gi ze 'brur bcang bar byos shig de ltar na rigs ldan rnam rgyal man chad kyi sprul gzhi rnams/ 'dir ni rgyud nyid khungs su byas pa yin la/ khyed gzhan rnams kyi rigs ldan bzang po man chad kyi sprul gzhi ngos 'dzin la shes byed kyi lung ci yang ma mthong ngo / /gnad des na gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa rigs ldan bzang po nas bzung ste/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa drag po 'khor lo can gyi bar nyer gsum po de la khro bo'i sprul pa bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa bcu gsum 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thog mar gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa gcig sprul gzhi'i bskor ba dang po la thugs dkyil gyi khro bo bgegs mthar byed/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rmugs byed/ khengs byed rnams kyi sprul pa bzhi ste lnga/ yang bskor mgo gnyis pa la khro bo'i sprul pa bzhi ste dgu/

slar yang bskor mgo bgegs mthar byed kyi sprul pa rigs ldan gcig ste/ de ltar khro bo'i sprul pa bcur nges pa'i phyir dang / byang sems kyi sprul pa yang / skor mgo dang po la byang sems kyi sprul pa drug yang skor mgo gnyis pa la byang sems kyi sprul pa drug yang skor gsum pa la phyag rdor gyi sprul pa drag po 'khor lo can de ltar bcu gsum du nges pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ shambha la yi pho brang nang / /rigs ldan nyer lnga'i sprul gzhi dang / /sprul pa so so'i rnam gzhag sogs/ /rgyud bzhin mkhyen pa mang du bzhugs/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan nyid/ /shin tu gsal phyir 'grel chen du'ang / /'di tsam go ba tshogs med snyam/ /'di thad go slar 'jog pa mdzad/ /sprul gzhi dang ni sprul pa rnams/ /yang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /rigs ldan 'khor tshul zhes bya ba'i/ /tha snyad mkhas pa gsal bar grags/ /kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di na/ /dus 'khor 'chad pa mang na yang / /zab mo rigs ldan 'khor tshul gnad/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa cher ma byon/ /gang 'dir rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /dad sgrol chen po grags pa dang / /'jam dbyangs sa los legs gsungs don/ /'khrul med rnyed nas ngas 'di brtsams/ /gzur gnas blo gsal don gnyer dag /rnam dpyod rnon pos dpyad gyis la/ /rgya chen bsod nams dang 'brel bas/ /'di 'dra'i legs bshad sgrogs par mdzod/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /yang 'dir skabs kyi khro bo bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po ngos 'dzin/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis thugs dkyil gyi khro bo bzhi/ sku dkyil gyi khro bo drug ste bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang sngar bshad pa'i drug gi steng du/ de dag las gzhan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' sna tshogs bsnan nas grangs 'dren par mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dbang las/

shambha la'i yul gru chen po der sngar bshad pa'i khro bo bzhi dang / byang chub sems dpa' drug po rnams yang yang bzlas te byon pa'i sgo nas/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nam yang mi nub pa'i tshul du nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa ni/ khro bo dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi bgo skal chen por gyur pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rigs ldan gyi yi ge las/ sprul pa'i rgyal po re re zhing / /lo ni brgya phrag lhag pa ru/ /seṅge'i khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /chos kyi 'jig rten skyong bar mdzad/ /des na rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ /shambha la yi yul du ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud/ /nam yang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sham bha la yi yul gru chen po na/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba zhig yod par nges shing / rigs ldan bzang po man chad kyis kyang brtsams chos du ma yod par sems pas/ gnas de dran pa tsam gyis rab tu dngas ba ci yang skyes so/ /de la kho na re/ khro bo dang byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don byed nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod bzhin du/ nges par sham bha la'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams sngar bshad pa'i khro bo bzhi dang / byang sems drug sprul pa kho nar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer na/ de ni sngar bshad pa ltar/ khro bo dang byang sems nges pa can de dag gi gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi 'phrin las kyi dbang las ste/ dper na/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig yod kyang / bskal pa bzang po 'di la ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan du/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gcig grangs dang go rim dang mtshan nges pa can du rim bzhin sngon gyi smon lam dang / gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang gis byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/

/'di dag gis ni/ a bha ya ka ras man ngag snye mar/ 'o na dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dang / de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i gzhung nas/ mang du theg pa gsum dang / 'ga' bar rnam par bzhag par byas pa des na/ de'i gzhung byed pa'i grags pa dang / padma dkar po dang / phyag na rdo rje'i ming can gyi byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no zhes mang du mkhyen pa rnams smras la/ des na 'gal ba thams cad mi spong bas/ 'gal ba bag tsam yang yod par byed do/ /ces dang / re mda' pa chen pos/ shambha la yi rigs ldan la sogs pa/ /sgrub bya yin gyi khyed kyi sgrub byed min/ /zhes smra ba'i log rtog rnams kyang sun dbyung ba yin te/ dbang dang rim gnyis kyi gnad khyad par ston pa'i rgyud sde 'di lta bu la skur ba btab na bla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad la skur ba btab par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang re mda' bas/ gang gis blangs pa'i khungs kyang mi snang na/ /'phyon ma'i bu bzhin 'di la su yid ston/ /zhes pa'ang / rnam par ma brtags pa'i gtam kho na yin te/ tsi lu paṇḍi tas dus 'khor rgya gar du spyan drangs tshul gyi lo rgyus khungs btsun tshad thub kyi yig rigs du ma yod cing / 'bro pa'i bla ma gong ma dag /tsi lu pa dang dus zhabs pa chen po gcig par 'dod la/ de nyid rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan yang bzhed pa'i phyir te/ des mdzad pa'i rigs ldan gyi yi ge las/ nyung ngu'i rgyud rgyal rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /'phags pa'i yul du gsal bar mdzad pa po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon tsi lu pa'i/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa 'grel mdzad snga ma'i bzhed srol la dpyad pa la/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye bar/ de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di la/ rnam bshad mdzad pa snga ma phal cher gyis gzhung gi tshig rigs sgra ji bzhin pa'i bshad pa tsam las legs bshad rtsal du thon pa'i bshad pa phul du phyin pa ma byung zhing /

rnam bshad mdzad pa spos khang pas/ /de tshe 'jam dpal grags pas yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /zhes gzhung 'don pa dang bsgyur bar mdzad la/ de nyid ku ma ra'i rnam bshad du'ang sgra ji bzhin du bris yod par snang ngo / /de la mkhas pa paṇa shag pas sprul pa skye ba'i shan ma phyed gsung pa'i dgag pa mdzad mod/ sprul pa dang skye ba nges par so so yin pa'i khungs thub kyi lung gang na ces 'dri'o/ /gang ltar yang gzhung bcos pa ni mi 'thad de/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i dpe gsar rnying thams cad na/ gzhung gi tshig rigs/ de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /zhes pa kho na kha mthun par 'byung bar/ rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i gzhung 'ga' zhig la bsgyur dag ma dag dbang las gzhung bcos dgos pa yang srid mod/ bod du brtsam pa'i gzhung la bcos par byed pa ni/ rtsom pa po sun 'byin pa'i tshig yin pas rgyang ring du dor bar bya'o/ /zhes gdams so/ /gzhan yang drag po 'khor lo can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin pa'i gnad 'khrul pa med pa'i gtam 'di dag rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa rmad du byung ba yin pa la nges pa ma brnyed par/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzhung 'don pa bsgyur ba ni/ yod yod kyi sgo bor nas med med kyi srang 'chag pa kho na yin par shes par byos shig yang paṇa shaka pas/ dri ba brgya rtsar/ rigs ldan drag po zhes bya ba/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa dngos/ /yin pa'i bshad pa gang na yod/ /ces dogs pa bkod nas/ de'i rang lan du/ phyi drang don gyi dbang du byas pa dang / /nang nges don gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis su phye nas/ dang po'i tshe/ de tshe 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya ba'i/ /ces sbyar dgos shing / nang nges don la sbyar ba'i tshe/ /rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can phyag rdor gyi sprul par bzhag pas chog ste/ de nyid thugs rdo rje yin par bshad pa gang zhig thugs rdo rje ni phyag na rdo rje yin pas so/

/de yang bsdus rgyud las/ 'khor lo can ni rang gi lus la rdo rje can ste lha mchog bdag rnams yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ ces 'chad do/ /'di yang mi 'thad de/ gzhung 'chos pa ni rtsom pa po la co 'dri bar byed cing / 'khor lo can ni rang gi lus la zhes pa'i don yang phyi rol du 'khor lo can dang / nang du thugs rdo rje gnyis mtshon bya mtshon byed du sbyar ba tsam yin gyi/ 'khor lo can thugs rdo rje dngos su gsungs pa gtan nas min pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te yin na/ phyi rol gyi lha chen bcu gnyis po de yang / nang gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pa yin par thal ba'i phyir dang / phyi rol gyi dpung tshogs yan lag dang po de/ 'phags pa'i tshad med bzhi yin par thal ba'i phyir dang / phyi rol du kla klo'i byed pa'i blo gros de/ nang gi dge ba bcu yin pa sogs ha cang thal ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ bsdus rgyud las/ 'khor lo can ni rang gi lus rdo rje can te/ zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ rigs ldan dag ni yang dag ye shes glang po rta dang shing rta mngag gzhug 'phags pa'i tshad med rnams/ /drag po rang rgyal du 'gyur ha nu man ni nyan thos dag ste gdug pa kla klo'i dbang / /srog chags rnams kyi sdig pa dag ste gang zhig byed pa'i blo gros sdug bsngal sbyin byed mi dga'i lam/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste/ sgyu ma'i gzugs kyang phyi rol du ni nges par ma kha'i yul du kla klo 'khrug ste 'khrug pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar tshig bcad gsum dang / de'i thad kyi 'grel chen la rtags pas smyon med du shes pa'i phyir/ gnad dus na rgyud sde chen po rnams las/ dag bya dag byed sbyar ba dang / /mtshon bya mtshon byed sbyar ba sogs rnam grangs du ma zhig bshad pa rnams de dang de dngos yin par khas blangs du ga la rung ste/ dper na brtag gnyis las/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/

/byams pa'i thugs las yan lag gnag /ces gsungs kyang kyai rdo rje'i snying rje chen po spyan dmar po yin pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i byams pa'i yan lag gnag pa yin pa sogs dpyod ldan su zhig gi khas len nus te mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rigs ldan 'khor tshul 'dir/ /drangs don gyi bshad pa dang / nges don gyi bshad pa zhes pa yang gtan nas thob pa min te/ 'di dag kun rdzob bden pa gtan la 'bebs byed yin te/ nges don gyi bshad pa zhes sbyar ba la rnam dpyad ci yang mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /yun ring 'bad pas btsal byas kyang / /legs bshad snying po ma rnyed pa'i/ /ltar snang lung rigs 'chad byed pa/ /de dag bde bar gnyid byos shig /gzhan yang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ drag po 'khor lo can phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin pa'i shes byed du/ sngar drangs pa'i/ 'khor lo can ni rang gi lus la rdo rje can te/ zhes 'dren par mdzad de zer ba'ang thos mod/ snying pos dben pa ste/ de'i thad kyi rgyu dang rgyud 'grel yig phreng sbrel nas ma gzigs pa'i skyon du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang gser thur mkhan pos/ rigs ldan drag po zhes bya ba/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa dngos/ /yin pa'i bshad pa ga na yod/ /ces pa'i lan du/ mkhas pa'i dbang po go bo rab 'byams pas sdom gsum 'khrul spong du 'di skad ces/ rigs ldan drag po de phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin par dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las bshad de/ rigs ldan drag po 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sprul pa yin/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa zla ba bzang po'i sprul pa yin/ /zla ba bzang po phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin par rgyud nyid las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dang po grub te/ 'grel chen du rtsa rgyud drangs par/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/

de'i zla bzang grub rgyud las/ /de ni bsdud par byed pa ste/ /rgyas 'grel byed pa pad 'dzin rang / /zhes bsdus rgyud mdzad pa po grags pa dang / 'grel bshad mdzad pa po pad dkar gnyis ka yang zla ba bzang po'i sprul par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /'di dag ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul la sbyangs pa cher ma gnang ba'i gsung 'ba' zhig tu snang ste/ rgyud rgyud 'grel gnyis ka'i dngos bstan la zla ba bzang po phyag rdor gyi sprul pa/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa/ rigs ldan pad dkar spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin par dngos su gsungs bzhin du/ 'jam dpal grags pa dang pad dkar gnyis phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin zhes khas len na/ 'di'i thad kyi sprul gzhi dang sprul pa'i rnam gzhag thams cad shin du 'chol par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ yang khyed kyis gong du drangs pa'i/ de yi zla bzang rtsa rgyud las/ /zhes sogs ni lung yang cung zad ma dag cing / lung gi go rim yang bar gong thon pas/ yid ches pa'i gnas su mi snang la/ lung dngos su 'di skad 'byung ste/ zla bzang de ni rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /de bzhin bsdud par byed pa ste/ /rgyas 'grel byed pa po yang khyod/ /'dir ni sems can yongs smin byed/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsdus rgyud la/ /rgyas 'grel byed pa pad 'dzin dang / /zhes gsungs shing / zla ba bzang po'i sprul pas bsdus rgyud byed ces pa'i don ma yin gyi/ zla ba bzang pos rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdud pa po byed ces pa'i don yin pa dang / rgyas 'grel byed pa po yang khyod/ /ces pa'i don yang / 'grel chen dri med mdzad pa'i rigs ldan pad dkar/ rgyal po zla bzang gi sprul pa yin zhes pa'i don ma yin gyi/ zla ba bzang pos rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad pa na/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi lung bstan pa tsam yin pas so/

/des na/ rgyas 'grel byed pa po yang khyod/ /ces pa'i skabs kyi rgyas 'grel ni dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi rgyal 'grel yin la/ rgyas 'grel byed pa pad 'dzin rang / /zhes pa'i skabs kyi rgyas 'grel ni/ bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel chen yin pas/ rgyas 'grel de gnyis thad so so ba yin pa'i don la nges pa bskyed par mdzad dgos so/ /gzhan yang go ram chen po'i gsung las/ rigs ldan drag po chen po/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa ma yin par thal/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs pa'i rdo rje rnon po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ zhes sogs gsungs mod/ de ltar yin na gong du zla bzang 'jam grags/ pad dkar gsum nges par phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin par sgrub pa la yang 'grel ma byung ste/ de gsum char phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs gsum char gyi sprul pa yin par khas len du rung bzhin du/ nges par phyag rdor gyi sprul pa kho nar sgrub pa'i don med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sdom gsum rab dbye'i rnam bshad mdzad pa mang po zhig gis/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa mi 'gal ba'i bshad pa mang po zhig gnang ba mthong mod/ mi 'thad de/ de ltar khas len rgyu yin na/ 'di'i thad kyi sprul gzhi dang sprul pa'i rnam gzhag bzhag mtshams thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir dang / spyir sprul pa la dbang thob pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dbyangs sogs gang 'dod du sprul nus pa yin mod kyi/ de'i tshe yang phyag na rdo rje'i rnam pa can yin na/ phyag na rdo rje yin pas ma khyab pa sogs khas len dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na 'dul ba'i sde snod du dud 'gro'i rnam pa can gyi dge slong bshad kyang / de dud 'gror khas ma blangs pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/

/des na phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dbyangs gnyis sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su kyi rgyud so so'i dbang gis sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na yang gzugs sku so sor 'jog pa dang / sngon gyi smon gyi dbang gis 'phrin las so sor nges pa sogs phyin ci ma log par khas len dgos pa la dgongs nas/ mdo sde rgyan du yang / longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu/ /'khor yongs bsdud dang zhing dang mtshon/ /sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /mdzad pa dag gis tha dad do/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa yin pas/ 'di dag snying gi zer 'brur bcang bar bya'o/ /mdor na rigs ldan drag po phyag rdor gyi sprul pa yin par nges pa la/ rigs ldan bzang po man chad rigs ldan nyer gsum gyi sprul gzhi phyin ci ma log par nges par dgos pa yin gyi/ gzhan rnams la 'di yin med par drag po 'khor lo can phyag rdor yin zhes smras pa tsam gyis chog pa la yin no/ /yang khyed ltar na/ skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong thugs rgyud gcig par khas len par 'gyur zhing / de 'dod na/ sangs rgyas stong la sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis 'khor 'dus pa'i grangs dang / bstan pa'i gnas tshad sogs 'phrin las tha dad par mdo sde skal bzang sogs las bshad pa de dag mi 'thad thal ba'i skyon gnas so/ /yang dam pa 'ga' zhig gi gsung las/ shambha lar drag po 'khor lo can nyid chos ston pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo can de nyid la phyag na rdo rje'am/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi thob pas na/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad pa'ang thos mod/ 'brel ci yang ma byung ste/ de ltar na shambha la'i chos rgyal dang rigs ldan thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin par thal ba'i phyir/ sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon yin na phyag na rdo rje yin pas khyab par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar mkhas pa snga ma'i bzhed srol la dpyad pa 'di dag gzur gnas kyi blos brtag par gyis la grub mtha' la blang dor byed dgos pa yin mod/
