'on kyang mkhas pa de dag la ma gus pa'i skur pa 'debs pa sogs ni gtan nas bya bar rigs pa ma yin te/ gsung rab kyi tshig don dpyis phyin shin tu 'grel dka' bas na/ mkhas pa re re'i rnam dpyod kyis gsung rab 'grel nus pa'ang dka' ba'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen re re yang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi phyag dang mchod pa dang / bstod pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes blo gsal rnams la bcos ma ma yin par gdams so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rang lugs 'khrul pa med pa'i gnad bstan pa ni/ grags pa rigs ldan de na slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ drag po 'khor lo can gyi yab/ /rigs ldan grags pa zhes pa zhig 'jog dgos par gzhung gi dngos bstan la grub/ bcu gsum de rnams rim pa yis/ /zhes pa'i rim pa de sprul gzhi gshin rje gshed dmigs gsal du byas/ gzhan rnams kyi sprul gzhi bshad zin gyis go rim de nyid sprul pa 'chad 'gyur gyi rigs ldan rnams la rim pa bzhin du sbyar bas/ nyer lnga pa drag po 'khor lo can phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa 'khrul med du grub pa 'di/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇḍi ta'i dgongs pa rmad du byung ba yin pas/ shes ldan mkhas pa blo gsal rnam dag rnam dpyod kyi padmo kha rab tu phyes bar gyis shig de la kho na re/ kla klo 'joms pa 'jam dpal grags pas byed dgos te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma las/ slar yang dang yang du de rnams bdag gis rtsod ldan dus su 'byin zhing 'joms pa ste/ zhes dang / kla klo'i dbang por grags pa gang dang gang zhig mun can gyur pa de rnams bdag gis drung byung ste/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ lung de dag ni 'gyur gyi skyon yin te/ tshig rkang snga ma las/ de rnams dag ni rtsod ldan dus su/ zhes dang / tshig rkang phyi ma la yang /

de rnams dag ni drung phyung ste/ /zhes 'byung rgyu la/ bdag tu bsgyur bas shin tu nor pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du de rnams rgyud tshig sgra ji bzhin yin na/ 'jam dbyangs grags pas kla klo'i 'joms shing drung nas phyung bar 'gyur la/ de ltar na kla klo ma bzhugs pa'i sngon nas kla klo bcom zin 'gyur bas bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /des na rgyud phyi ma la gnyan lo'i 'gyur sogs gsum tsam las mi snang zhing / 'gyur dag ma dag yang sna tshogs yod ces mkhas pa rnams gsung ngo / /yang kho na re/ drag po 'khor lo can rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa'i skye ba yin te/ bsdus rgyud las/ brgyad pa dpal ldan grags pa yang / /'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha yi mchog gi btud pa rdo rje'i rigs kyis rigs ldan te/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin nas mtha' dag thub pa'i rigs rnams dag ni rigs can dag tu byed par 'gyur/ /yang dag theg pa mngon 'dzegs lha min rigs la 'jigs ster dpal grags pa phyag na mdung thung can/ sems can rnams kyis thar pa'i slad du sa la dus kyi 'khor lo rab tu gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha yis mchog gis btud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ skyon yod pa ma yin te/ gzhung de dag kyang tshig rkang go rim sgrig tshul cung zad ma byung ba'i 'gyur skyon kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang lo tsā ba 'ga' zhig gis ni/ grags pa rigs ldan de nas slar/ /de sras 'khor lo chen po can/ /zhes pa'i don/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa nyid slar zlas te byon pa drag po 'khor can yin no/ /zhes pa'i don du bzung de nyid thugs yul du bzhag nas/ de dang mthun par/ legs sbyar gyi skad gong 'og bsnor nas bsgyur bas don cung zad nor ba yin par the tshom med do/

/de'i gnad kyang sgra sbyor bam gnyis su grags pa bye brag rtogs byed 'bring po las/ rgya gar gyi skad kyi go rim las mi bsnor bar/ bod kyi skad du bsgyur na don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing bde na ma bsnor bar bsgyur shing / bsnor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa zhig yod na tshig bcad la ni rtsa ba bzhi pa'am drug pa'ang rung ste tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi ni nang na gang bde bar bsnor zhing bsgyur cig ces gsungs pa ltar du/ tshig rkang drug yan chad kyi nang du legs sbyar gyi skad go rim gnas kyang / bod skad kyi go rim tshig don 'brel gang chags su bsgyur dgos shing / de yang rgya dpe dang bstun na/ tshig rkang gi go rim dang 'don khyer 'di bzhin du yod par sems te/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin nas mtha' dag thub pa'i rigs rnam dag ni rigs gcig dag tu byed par 'gyur/ /gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/ /rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha yi mchog gi bstud pa drag po'i rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang dag theg par mngon 'dzegs lha min rigs la 'jigs ster dpal ldan drag po phyag na mdung thung can/ /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du sa la dus kyi 'khor lo rab tu gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs kyis bde ba ster shing de bzhin kla klo'i rigs la mthar byed nyid/ /ces pa zhig yod par gdon mi za mod/ 'on kyang slar rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhib tu bshad par bya'o/ /de las gzhan du khyed kyi drangs pa de bsdus rgyud kyi tshig gi go rim sgra ji bzhin pa yin na/ dpal ldan grags pa phyag na mdung thung can/ /zhes par/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i skye ba drag po 'khor lo can bstan par song zhing / de'i tshe/ gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/

zhes pa dang zlos pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/ drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes bshad ma thag tu slar yang drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes bshad par song 'dug pas so/ /gal te dpal ldan grags pa phyag na mdung thung can/ /zhes par rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa bstan zhing / drag po 'khor lo can ma bsten par khas len na/ 'jam dpal grags pa mdung thung gi phyag mtshan can du 'dod dgos pas/ e ma bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /gnad des na kho bos drangs pa de ltar du bshad pas don dang shin tu 'byor te/ 'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha yi mchog gis bstud pa rdo rje'i rigs kyis rigs ldan te/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur byin nas mtha' dag thub pa'i rigs rnams dag ni rigs gcig dag tu byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pas rigs ldan gyi thog ma rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pa bstan/ gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis/ 'jam dpal grags pa nas nyi shu rtsa lnga bgrangs pa'i mtha' mar drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhes bstan/ yang dag theg par mngon 'dzegs zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig gis drag po 'khor lo de'i mdzad pa 'phrin las bstan/ /rigs ldan rigs kyi nang nas lag pas bsgyur ba'i dus kyi bu dang tsha bo dag ni 'das gyur pa/ /zhes sogs kyis kla klo 'jug pa'i dus su/ bzhugs pa'i kla klo 'joms tshul sogs bstan pa yin pas/ dpyod ldan gzur gnas yod na 'di bzhin du nges par gyis shig spyir yang dus 'khor rgyud gyi 'grel 'di dag 'phral go sla mdog yin pa la/ zhib tu rtags tshe ha cang gsal ba ma yin pa dang / brjod bya'i don re re yang nang tshan ma rdzogs pa dang / sdeb sbyor bying che ba'i dbang gis myur du rtogs par mi nus pa zhig yod la/ de'i dbang gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang / rgyud don dpyis phyin par dgongs pa'i sgo nas 'chad rtsom gyis dga' ston spel ba cher ma byon pa ni/

dper na rigs ldan 'khor tshul bzhin no/ /don 'di la dgongs nas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gza' lnga'i rtsis kyi yi ge las/ grags pa mi dbang gis sdeb nyung ngu'i rgyud/ shin tu gsal min cig nang ma rdzogs shing / /sdeb sbyor bying che myur du rtogs min las/ /'di ni blo dman bzung phyir gsal bar bgyis/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'di'i sdeb sbyor bying che zhes pa'i don yang / bsdus rgyud 'di rgya dpe'i steng na sdeb sbyor bying shin tu che bar bzhugs pas na/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis kyang sgra ji bzhin ma 'gyur ba mang du yod ces bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar 'di dag gis ni rab dbye bstan bcos chen por de'i tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ zhes sogs bshad pa'i don dpyis phyin par bkral ba yin la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs tshul ni kho bos logs su bkod yod cing / 'khor lo can gang du 'byon pa'i shambha la'i rnam gzhag gzhom bya kla klo 'jug pa'i dus kla klo'i gnas tshad/ drag po'i kla klo 'joms pa'i yun bcom nas 'khor lo can gyi dus bzhi 'byung tshul rnams ni 'dir mang du dogs pas logs su bshad par bya'o/ /'di tsam gyis kyang dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byas par sems so/ /rgya chen gnyis med rgyud rgyal du sa 'khor lo'i/ rgyud don g.yur za ldem pa pad mo'i tshal/ /gang gi mkhyen rab zer gyis gsal mdzad pa/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon bzhed gzhung snying po'i don/ /sngar byon mkhas pa du mas yun ring du/ /'bad pas btsal kyang phyogs tsam ma brnyed pa'i/ /ngal ba'i 'khun sgras rab dbye'i bstan bcos che/ /'gog la brtson pa'i bshad sgros sna tshogs byung / /de tshe 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung dngos la/ /'khrul pa yod pa nam yang srid min pas/ /'grel mdzad rnams kyis 'khyog par bkra lam snyam/

/rtog cing dpyod pa'i mel tshe rgya sring tshe/ /rtsa rgyud dngos bstan tshig don 'khrul med gtam/ /thos pa tsam gyis rgyud don gsal bar mthong / /rjes 'brang 'brel mdzad de dag ci red snyam/ /'jam mgon gzhung la dad pa lhag par 'phel/ /rdo rje'i thugs mnga' grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rigs ldan 'khor tshul gsal bar gsungs pa dang / /dri med 'od sogs lung rigs la brten nas/ /rab dbye'i gzhung don shin tu gsal bar bgyis/ /skye ba du mar rdo rje theg pa la/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i skyes stobs mi dman zhing / /dam pa'i drin las gsung rab gang gang gi /dka' ba'i gnad rnams ji bzhin shes snyam byed/ /don gnyer blo gsal rnams dpyod ldan pa rnams/ /'di 'dra'i legs bshad tshul bzhin nges gyis la/ /dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i dbus su ngom gyis dang / /bstan dang 'gro la phan par gdon mi za/ /'di ltar bshad pa'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin blo gsal legs bshad don gnyer bas/ /sa 'di yongs gang chos sgra sgrog par shog /ces rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag 'di yang rang gi slob ma du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /shākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa mang thos 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ dpal gnyan yod bya rgod gshongs legs bshad sgrogs pa'i tshal chen por legs par sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar de dag gis ni dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag mkhas pa gong ma'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba rnams lhan cig tu sgrigs pa legs bshad mkhas pa'i kha rgyan zhes bya ba ma tshang ba med pa bstan zin to// ༈ //de ltar dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lor las/ /gsungs pa'i rigs ldan rnams kyi rnam gzhag la/ /mkhas pa gong ma'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba/ /mang du mchis pa lhan cig sdeb pa yi/ /sngon chad legs bshad mkhas pa'i kha brgyan 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/

/ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /dus 'khor dbang rgyud man ngag la sogs pa'i/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho nos pa'i skal bzang des/ /sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /bzang po'i tshes la bzhi thog bla brang gi /'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa/ /sa skyar skyes pa'i nor bu lha sbyin no/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir bsam pa mthar phyin bstan pa rgyas/ /'chi tshe bar do med par dag pa'i zhing / /thogs med sgrod nas rang don mthar phyin ste/ /gang 'dul sprul pas bstan pa spyi bye brag /rab tu rgyas pa'i 'phrin las bsam yas kyi/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun bzang 'dis/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs khyab pa'i mthu ldan shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ ngag nas lan gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i rigs ldan gyi rnam gzhag bzhed srol mi 'dra ba lhan cig tu bsgrigs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
